task_template: Finish with the uppermost {side} drawer, immediately under the countertop, pulled out by at least roughly half its depth. Left and right refer to the robot's starting position. Grade the state at the END of the video: the correct top drawer must still be open far enough then. Earlier opening followed by pushing it back does not complete this task. A lower open drawer does not count.
native_instruction_rewrite: Deterministic side extraction only; explicit native target and terminal predicate
